error[MBS-E4]: this shader uses 131 uniform registers; the 3DS has 96
  --> e04_too_many_uniforms.mbs:22:12
   |
22 | @(uniform) palette: [30]matrix[4, 4]f32
   |            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the largest, 120 registers
   |
   = note: a `matrix[4, 4]f32` takes 4, a `[4]f32` takes 1 and an `f32` takes 1; `palette` uses 120, `render` uses 7, `frame` uses 4
   = help: `palette` is the largest; lower its length, or compute part of it on the CPU
